subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as core `tui.footer` config, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK/rendering seam, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses public config, TUI rendering, provider usage/auth, and Plugin SDK boundaries; automation cannot safely choose the long-term compatibility contract.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add a TUI render path and provider-usage fields after the API shape, ordering, truncation, and caching policy are approved.

options.title: Core config template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui.footer` template/config surface, accepting the compatibility and migration burden for a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep existing status surfaces
options.body: Leave `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and menu-bar usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and close persistent footer customization as not planned.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add a TUI render path and provider-usage fields after the API shape, ordering, truncation, and caching policy are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: History connects this person to provider-usage/status behavior and plugin registry/API boundary work, which are the central tradeoffs here.
